info.title: Libris automation API
info.summary: Send books to a Libris server and get them back translated, with no human step.
info.description:
Send an EPUB, TXT chapters or a JSON document to a Libris server, let it translate on its own, then
download the result with its completion report. Nothing needs a person along the way.

**Authentication.** Every call carries an API token: `Authorization: Bearer lbr_…`. Tokens are created
in the interface (**My account › API tokens**); each one carries scopes, named on every operation below.
The session cookie of the web interface never opens `/api/v1`.

**Asynchronous work.** A request is saved before the `202 Accepted` answer and runs in the worker.
Poll its status (`?wait=` long-polls up to 60 seconds by default) or receive a signed webhook when it
ends. A request always ends: `completed`, `completed_with_residuals`, `failed` or `cancelled`
(`imported` when it only imported chapters).

**Errors.** Every error is `{"detail": {"code", "message", …}}`. `code` is stable; `message` is in
French, or in English with `Accept-Language: en`. Validation errors never echo the submitted text.

**Limits.** Calls per token and per minute (`API_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`, `429` with `Retry-After`), body
size (`API_MAX_PAYLOAD_MB`) and chapters per request (`API_MAX_CHAPTERS`) are set by the server's
administrator.

The full guide, with `curl` examples, is [docs/api.md](https://github.com/HeartBtz/Libris/blob/main/docs/api.md).

post.description:
Send **an EPUB** (multipart field `file`, or the raw file as `application/epub+zip` with its options in the query string), **TXT or DOCX chapters** (multipart, one or more `.txt` or `.docx` files in `file` or `files`, one chapter each, or one file split at its chapter headings with `split=headings`) or **a JSON document**. One request carries one kind of file.

The request is stored before the answer and its pipeline starts in the worker: `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header. The same content sent again with the same `Idempotency-Key` or `external_id` answers `200` with the original request and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Without the `pipeline:start` scope, send `start=false` to import only.

Chapters sent to a volume already translated (`volume.latest`, or the same volume again) are appended and only they are translated. The request waits its turn in the fair queue at the `priority` it asks for, and is refused when its token's cost budget is reached.

**Scope:** `content:write`, and `pipeline:start` to start the pipeline.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1–200 printable characters. Sending the same content again with the same key answers `200` with the original request; different content answers `409 idempotency_conflict`.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). The file name, used to guess the volume number.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Your identifier of the request (same rules as in the JSON document).

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). The series by name, created when missing (not with `series_id`). Required for TXT.

parameters.name: series_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). The series by id (not with `series`).

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Volume number, 1–10000, or `latest` for the series' last volume (TXT only). Required for TXT; for an EPUB in a series, taken from the file name when free, otherwise the next number.

parameters.name: volume_external_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Your identifier of the volume.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Volume title (an EPUB keeps its own otherwise).

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Author of the volume.

parameters.name: source_language
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). BCP 47 tag such as `en`, `fr-FR`, `zh-Hant`.

parameters.name: target_language
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). BCP 47 tag.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Provider to use; defaults to the volume's, then the series' provider.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`).

parameters.name: context_backend
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Run the whole pipeline (needs the `pipeline:start` scope); false only imports.

parameters.name: final_review
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Run the final review (never when the server disables it).

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Default format of the result; `epub` only for an EPUB (and its default); `epub-bilingual` is a bilingual EPUB for proofreading, for any input.

parameters.name: callback_url
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Webhook called when the request ends; its host must be allowed by an administrator.

parameters.name: callback_events
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Comma-separated extra webhooks, for example `chapters.translated`.

parameters.name: replace_changed_chapters
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Replace chapters already imported with another text (otherwise `409 chapter_conflict`). Unchanged passages keep their translation.

parameters.name: discard_human
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). With `replace_changed_chapters`: allow dropping passages a person edited or validated (otherwise `409 conflict`).

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Place in the fair queue: `low`, `normal` (default) or `high`, within the token's `max_priority` and its account's ceiling (otherwise `403 priority_not_allowed`). Does not change what the request is.

parameters.name: analysis_mode
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). `parallel`: the passages are analysed side by side, then each is reconciled with what precedes it; `strict`: one passage after the other. Default: the volume's choice, else `ANALYSIS_MODE`.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Passages worked on at once, analysis and translation alike (1–64). It can only lower the volume's share of the provider's capacity; default: that share.

parameters.name: split
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). TXT or DOCX: `headings` splits one file holding many chapters at its chapter headings (numbers and titles from the headings, the split recorded in `report.decisions.intake`); `none` (default) keeps each file as one chapter. Refused for an EPUB.

schema.description: An EPUB (one file in `file`), TXT or DOCX chapters (one or more `.txt` or `.docx` files in `file` or `files`; `series` or `series_id`, `volume`, `source_language` and `target_language` required) or one `.json` document in `file` with no other field. Empty fields count as not given; unknown fields are refused.

file.description: The EPUB, the JSON document or a TXT or DOCX chapter.

files.description: TXT or DOCX chapters, one file each, numbered from their names.

external_id.description: Your identifier of the request (same rules as in the JSON document).

series.description: The series by name, created when missing (not with `series_id`). Required for TXT.

volume.description: Volume number, 1–10000, or `latest` for the series' last volume (TXT only). Required for TXT; for an EPUB in a series, taken from the file name when free, otherwise the next number.

title.description: Volume title (an EPUB keeps its own otherwise).

provider_id.description: Provider to use; defaults to the volume's, then the series' provider.

start.description: Run the whole pipeline (needs the `pipeline:start` scope); false only imports.

final_review.description: Run the final review (never when the server disables it).

output_format.description: Default format of the result; `epub` only for an EPUB (and its default); `epub-bilingual` is a bilingual EPUB for proofreading, for any input.

callback_url.description: Webhook called when the request ends; its host must be allowed by an administrator.

replace_changed_chapters.description: Replace chapters already imported with another text (otherwise `409 chapter_conflict`). Unchanged passages keep their translation.

discard_human.description: With `replace_changed_chapters`: allow dropping passages a person edited or validated (otherwise `409 conflict`).

priority.description: Place in the fair queue: `low`, `normal` (default) or `high`, within the token's `max_priority` and its account's ceiling (otherwise `403 priority_not_allowed`). Does not change what the request is.

analysis_mode.description: `parallel`: the passages are analysed side by side, then each is reconciled with what precedes it; `strict`: one passage after the other. Default: the volume's choice, else `ANALYSIS_MODE`.

threads.description: Passages worked on at once, analysis and translation alike (1–64). It can only lower the volume's share of the provider's capacity; default: that share.

split.description: TXT or DOCX: `headings` splits one file holding many chapters at its chapter headings (numbers and titles from the headings, the split recorded in `report.decisions.intake`); `none` (default) keeps each file as one chapter. Refused for an EPUB.

202.description: Accepted: the request is stored and will run in the worker.

200.description: Replayed: this content was already sent with this key or `external_id`.

401.description: A missing, unknown, revoked or expired token, or a disabled account (header `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). Codes: `missing_token`, `invalid_token`, `revoked_token`, `expired_token`, `inactive_account`, `unauthorized`.

detail.message: Jeton d’API manquant : envoyez « Authorization: Bearer <jeton> ».

402.description: The token's cost budget is reached (`budget` gives the cap, the spend, the period and when it resets); a request that only imports (`start` false) is still accepted. Codes: `budget_exceeded`.

403.description: The token lacks a scope (`scope` names it), a browser page from another site, or the priority asked for is above the token's or the account's ceiling (`max_priority`). Codes: `insufficient_scope`, `forbidden`, `priority_not_allowed`.

Priorité « high » refusée : « normal » au plus pour ce compte ou ce jeton.

404.description: The series named by `id` does not exist, or `create_if_missing` is false. Codes: `series_not_found`.

detail.message: Série introuvable.

409.description: The content cannot be taken as it is. Codes: `idempotency_conflict`, `chapter_conflict`, `conflict`, `volume_conflict`, `series_archived`, `volume_archived`.

detail.message: Une autre requête a déjà utilisé cette clé d’idempotence ou cet external_id avec un contenu différent.

415.description: Neither JSON, EPUB nor multipart. Codes: `unsupported_media_type`.

422.description: The document, the upload or an option is invalid. Codes: `invalid_payload`, `invalid_idempotency_key`, `unknown_provider`, `provider_required`, `invalid_epub`, `callback_refused`.

429.description: Too many calls for this token (retry after `Retry-After` seconds), or the token or its account already has its quota of requests waiting to start (`scope`, `limit`): nothing is stored, retry once one of them has started. Codes: `rate_limited`, `queue_full`.

get.description:
The chapters of the request in reading order (the whole book for an EPUB), as an EPUB (EPUB requests only), a bilingual EPUB for proofreading (`epub-bilingual`, any input, `layout` interleaved or side by side), a JSON document, one UTF-8 text file, or a ZIP of one text file per chapter with a `manifest.json`. `?format=` wins, then the `Accept` header, then the request's own format. `scope` chooses the chapters: the request's, only its new ones, or the whole volume.

Passages without a translation keep their source text. Before the end the answer is `409 result_not_ready` (with `Retry-After`), unless `partial=true`.

**Scope:** `results:read`.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request's `request_id`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Result format; wins over the `Accept` header. Default: the request's own format (EPUB for an EPUB).

parameters.name: partial
parameters.description: Return what is translated so far instead of `409 result_not_ready` (missing passages keep their source text; `X-Libris-Complete: false`).

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Long poll: answer as soon as the request ends, or after this many seconds (bounded by the server's `API_RESULT_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS`, 60 by default).

parameters.name: layout
parameters.description: `format=epub-bilingual` only: each source paragraph followed by its translation (`interleaved`) or next to it in two columns that stack on a narrow screen (`side-by-side`).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The chapters covered: those the request sent (`request`, the whole book for an EPUB), only those it created or replaced (`new`), or every chapter of the volume (`volume`). `epub` is always the whole book.

200.description: The result. `X-Libris-Complete` tells whether every passage is translated. `application/epub+zip`: The translated EPUB (`format=epub`), or the bilingual EPUB (`format=epub-bilingual`). `application/json`: The JSON document (`format=json`). `text/plain`: One UTF-8 text file, chapters under their headings (`format=txt`). `application/zip`: `chapters/001 - Title.txt`… and `manifest.json` with each file's SHA-256 (`format=txt-zip`).

post.summary: Pause, resume or cancel a request
post.description:
Same rules as the interface. A request without a job yet (`queued`) can only be cancelled. Resuming a job paused by a cost budget is refused until the budget is raised, and resuming counts as a new entry in the queue. Answers with the status document.

**Scope:** `jobs:control`.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request's `request_id`.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: `pause`, `resume` or `cancel`.

500.description: Unexpected failure; the message carries a diagnostic reference for the server logs. Codes: `server_error`.

post.description: Sent by the worker to the request's `callback_url` while its job runs, once per batch of chapters whose passages all have a translation, when the request listed `chapters.translated` in `callback_events`. Batches go before the final webhook when both are due, but a retried batch can arrive after it: order them by `batch`. The text of a batch is a draft until the request ends. Check the signature over the raw body and refuse old timestamps. Any `2xx` counts as delivered; anything else is retried with an exponential backoff (30 s, 60 s… up to one hour) at most `API_WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS` times. Redirects are not followed.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Event
parameters.description: `chapters.translated`.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Delivery
parameters.description: `<request id>:chapters.translated:<batch>:<attempt number>`.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Signature
parameters.description: `sha256=<hex>`: HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<raw body>` with the token's webhook secret, or the server's `API_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

AnalysisPhase.description: Where a running analysis is; `null` when no analysis runs.

step.description: Parallel analysis: `extraction`, `consolidation`, `reconciliation`, `memory`, then `book_bible`; strict analysis: `chapter_analysis`, then `book_bible`.

current.description: Passages (or Book Bible syntheses) started in this step.

level.description: `book_bible` of a parallel analysis: the level of the tree being built.

levels.description: Levels of the Book Bible tree.

percent.description: How far the whole analysis is, 0–100.

ChapterCounts.description: How many chapters the request created, found unchanged or replaced, and each chapter's progress.

new.description: The chapters the request created or replaced (ids): the ones a follow-up translates.

waiting_chapters.description: Chapters of the request not translated (nor announced) yet.

error.description: Last failure of a batch, empty when none.

external_id.description: Your identifier of the chapter: sending it again finds the same chapter.

number.description: Chapter number, 0–100000; decimals such as `12.5` allowed. Chapters are ordered by it.

title.description: Optional; without it the chapter is named by its number.

content.description: The chapter's text (not blank, at most `TEXT_CHAPTER_MAX_CHARS` characters).

flagged.description: Passages still flagged (`check`, `error`, `refused`) and not validated.

ChaptersTranslatedEvent.description: Sent while the job runs, once per batch of chapters whose passages all have a translation.

batch.description: Counts from 1 per request; order batches by it.

chapters.description: The chapters of this batch, in reading order.

announced.description: Chapters announced so far, this batch included.

CompletionReport.description: What was translated, what kept its source and why, what it cost and how long it took, and the quality scores of its passages.

reason.description: Why the request did not complete.

passages.description: Counts over the request's passages (the whole book for an EPUB).

residuals.description: At most 500; `residuals_truncated` tells when the list is cut.

autopilot.description: Decisions the autopilot logged for the job.

intake.description: Choices made when reading the upload (volume and chapter numbers, encoding, reused EPUB), each with its reason.

delivery.description: EPUB only: EPUBCheck `validation`, `repairs`, `inherited_errors`, and `errors` when the delivery failed.

CostReport.description: Estimated against real cost, in the currency of the provider prices, with the book's budget.

estimated.description: The estimate made when the job started; `null` when none was made.

actual.description: The job's real cost (`usage.cost`); `null` when no call had a price.

budget.description: The book's cost budget; `null` without one.

book_spent.description: What the book has cost in all, every job included.

warning.description: The warning given at launch when the estimate exceeded what was left of a budget.

paused_for_budget.description: Whether the job is paused because a budget was reached.

provider_switches.description: How many times the job moved to a cheaper fallback provider to stay within a budget.

Error.description: Every error of the automation API.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, French by default, English with `Accept-Language: en`.

scope.description: The missing scope (`insufficient_scope`), or whose quota is full, `token` or `account` (`queue_full`).

max_priority.description: The highest priority the token and its account may ask for (`priority_not_allowed`).

budget.description: The token's cost budget (`budget_exceeded` answered with `402`).

amount.description: The token's cap, in the currency of the provider prices.

spent.description: What the current period has spent.

resets_at.description: Start of the next month (Unix time); `null` for a total cap.

request_id.description: The request that already used this key (`idempotency_conflict`).

reason.description: Why the request failed or was cancelled.

conflicts.description: Chapters already imported with another text (`chapter_conflict`).

protected_segments.description: Passages edited by a person that a replacement would drop.

GlossaryImportForm.description: A glossary file and how to read it. CSV files may carry a byte order mark; French or English headers are recognised.

file.description: The glossary: JSON, CSV or TBX (v2 and v3), 2 MB at most.

strategy.description: `skip` keeps the terms in place; `replace` replaces unlocked terms that differ; `replace_all` replaces locked ones too.

mapping.description: JSON object from field to column number (from 0), for example `{"source": 0, "translation": 2}`; from the headers when absent.

header.description: Whether the first row holds column names; detected when absent.

skip_invalid.description: Leave invalid rows out instead of refusing the file.

GlossaryImportReport.description: The import plan: what the file adds, what conflicts with the terms in place and what is invalid.

columns.description: The first row of a CSV file.

conflicts.description: Sources already present with other values: `existing`, `incoming`, the differing `fields`, `locked` and the `action` (`replace` or `keep`); at most 200.

duplicates.description: A source repeated in the file (the first row counts); at most 200.

truncated.description: Whether a list was cut at 200 items.

skipped.description: Applied imports only: terms left as they were.

strategy.description: Provider name and model (never its address or key), `quality`, `context_backend`, `final_review`.

scope.description: What the result covers: the request's chapters, only the new ones, or the whole volume.

format.description: Default format of the result; `epub-bilingual` is a bilingual EPUB for proofreading.

start.description: Run the whole pipeline (needs the `pipeline:start` scope); false only imports.

provider_id.description: Provider to use; defaults to the volume's, then the series' provider.

final_review.description: Run the final review (never when the server disables it).

priority.description: Place in the fair queue: `low`, `normal` (default) or `high`, within the token's `max_priority` and its account's ceiling (otherwise `403 priority_not_allowed`). Does not change what the request is.

analysis_mode.description: `parallel`: the passages are analysed side by side, then each is reconciled with what precedes it; `strict`: one passage after the other. Default: the volume's choice, else `ANALYSIS_MODE`.

threads.description: Passages worked on at once, analysis and translation alike (1–64). It can only lower the volume's share of the provider's capacity; default: that share.

segments.description: Passages of the request's chapters (the whole book for an EPUB).

Provider.description: A provider a request may name: identity and model only, never an address or a key.

default_for_series.description: Your series that use this provider by default.

QualityReport.description: Quality scores (0–100) of the passages the request covers, computed from the signals Libris records (checks, critiques, doubts, failed calls, recoveries, retained originals); no model call.

average.description: Average score (0–100); `null` when none is scored.

histogram.description: Passages per ten-point bucket, from 0–9 to 90–100.

to_review.description: Passages below `review_below` that no person validated.

review_below.description: The score under which a passage should be reviewed.

weakest_chapters.description: The 10 chapters with the lowest scores: `chapter_id`, `title`, `external_id`, `number`, `passages`, `scored`, `average`, `minimum`, `weak`…

review_first.description: The 10 passages to review first: `segment_id`, `chapter_id`, `position`, `score`, `band` and the `signals` (`code`, `count`, `penalty`) that lowered them.

QueuePlace.description: Where a request that has not started yet stands in the fair queue.

position.description: Place in the line of its provider (1: next); `null` when it waits for its volume.

reason.description: Why it waits: `starting`, `provider_busy`, `account_limit`, `token_limit`, `retry_scheduled`, `provider_missing`, or `volume_busy` while another job holds the volume.

effective_priority.description: Its priority, raised one level after a long wait.

next_attempt.description: When a waiting job retries (Unix time, `0` when not waiting).

RequestDetail.description: The status document of a request.

job_id.description: The pipeline job; `null` while the request waits (`queued`).

stage.description: Current stage of the volume (`null` without a job).

step.description: Current step of the job, for example `translation`, `final_review`.

estimate.description: Remaining time and cost, once enough calls were observed.

error.description: Why the job stopped or failed; empty otherwise.

next_attempt.description: When a waiting job retries (Unix time, `0` when not waiting).

priority.description: The request's priority, as changed by a person in the interface if it was.

RequestStatus.description: `queued`: waiting for its volume. `imported`: chapters imported, nothing started (end state). `pending`/`running`: the job waits for a worker or works. `paused`, `waiting` (provider temporarily unavailable, retried), `blocked` (needs attention). `finalizing`: the result is being built. End states: `completed`, `completed_with_residuals` (some passages kept their source, listed in the report), `failed`, `cancelled`.

RequestSummary.description: A translation request, as answered when it is created.

job_id.description: The pipeline job; `null` while the request waits (`queued`).

Residual.description: A passage delivered in its source text.

reason.description: The autopilot's reason, the passage's last error, or `source_retained`, `untranslated`, `markup_mismatch`, `epubcheck_repair`.

translation.description: The chapter's text; missing passages keep their source text.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized source text (`null` when not recorded).

name.description: Found by name; created when missing unless `create_if_missing` is false.

create_if_missing.description: Create the series named by `name` when it does not exist.

SeriesSharedGlossary.description: The shared glossary the series follows, with its terms; `null` when it follows none.

SharedGlossary.description: A named glossary several series of the same universe follow. Its accepted terms come after the book's and the series' own (book > series > shared glossary).

locked_count.description: Locked terms: enforced and checked in every passage.

SharedGlossaryAttachment.description: The shared glossary a series follows.

glossary_id.description: The shared glossary to follow; `null` detaches the series.

SharedGlossaryDetail.description: A shared glossary with its terms.

locked_count.description: Locked terms: enforced and checked in every passage.

name.description: 1–200 characters, unique among your shared glossaries.

source_language.description: BCP 47 tag; with the target, the glossary only applies to volumes of that pair.

locked.description: Enforced by the pipeline and the autopilot, checked in every passage.

StoredResult.description: The result file stored when the request ended successfully.

external_id.description: Your identifier of the request: a letter or digit, then letters, digits and `._:/-` (200 at most). Unique per owner: the same content sent again returns the original request.

volume.description: The volume: found by `external_id`, then by `number` in the series; otherwise created.

chapters.description: 1 to `API_MAX_CHAPTERS` chapters; numbers and `external_id`s must not repeat.

replace_changed_chapters.description: Replace chapters already imported with another text (otherwise `409 chapter_conflict`). Unchanged passages keep their translation.

discard_human.description: With `replace_changed_chapters`: allow dropping passages a person edited or validated (otherwise `409 conflict`).

callback_url.description: Webhook called when the request ends; its host must be allowed by an administrator.

callback_events.description: Extra webhooks on top of `translation_request.finished`: `chapters.translated` sends one per batch of chapters translated while the job runs.

TranslationPayload.description: A JSON translation request. Unknown fields are refused; nothing is ever downloaded from a URL it names.

Usage.description: Model calls of the request's job.

cost.description: Cost of the calls with a known price; `null` when none had one.

loc.description: Where the problem is, for example `["chapters", 0, "number"]`.

msg.description: What is wrong (the submitted value is never repeated).

latest.description: Follow up a webnovel: the chapters go to the series' last numbered volume (else its continuous chapter container, else volume 1). Not with `number`.

number.description: Volume number, 1–10000. Required unless `latest` is true.

title.description: Title of a new volume (default: “Series — number”).

WebhookEvent.description: Sent once when a request ends (any end state, `imported` included).

bearerToken.description: An API token created in the interface (My account › API tokens).
